label: Logo Animate
description: Drop in an SVG logo — get an animated logo video. The SVG becomes real m0 geometry (one cell per shape, silhouette masks), animated per-tile: assemble-in, seamless loop, progress fill, breathing glow, or shimmer.

svgPath.label: Logo SVG
svgPath.description: Your logo as an SVG file. Only <path>/<rect> shapes are parsed — flatten with Inkscape's Object to Path first if needed.

svg.label: SVG string
svg.description: Inline SVG content. Bypasses the file picker — useful for CLI/programmatic callers. Leave both empty to see the placeholder mark.

driftPercent.label: Drift %
driftPercent.description: Drift tolerance for grid inference (% of min canvas dim). 0 traces exactly; a logo too fine to fit the canvas snaps to the smallest tolerance that fits.

bitmap.label: Bitmap mode
bitmap.description: Rasterize the SVG to a pixel grid and animate pixel-by-pixel. Opt-in — a high-resolution grid is a heavy render. Use when a logo converts to a single shape and won't otherwise animate.

bitmapPrecision.label: Bitmap precision
bitmapPrecision.description: Bitmap-mode fidelity (raster resolution). Higher = crisper but far more frames / slower renders. ultra (512²) is maximum fidelity — it renders but is too heavy to preview live.

animation.label: Animation
animation.description: assemble: tiles spawn in, hold, fade out · logo_loop: seamless reveal loop · progress_fill: fills like a loading bar · breathing: pulsing glow with a travelling shine · shimmer: travelling highlight band.

rankSet.label: Order
rankSet.description: Tile ordering: scatter (pixelate-in), diag (corner sweep), cascade, radial (center-out).

spawnDurMs.label: Spawn (ms)
spawnDurMs.description: Stagger from first to last tile starting its fade-in.

holdDurMs.label: Hold (ms)
holdDurMs.description: Hold duration at full alpha before fade-out begins.

tileOffsetPx.label: Settle (px)
tileOffsetPx.description: Pixel offset (down/right) each tile settles from.

progress.label: Progress
progress.description: Static fill level (0..1). Leave empty to animate the fill.

oneShot.label: One-shot
oneShot.description: Fill once and hold instead of repeating.

shimmerWidth.label: Band width
shimmerWidth.description: Band width as a fraction of rank space (shimmer + breathing).

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: "contain" letterboxes the logo at its own aspect; "fill" stretches it across the canvas.

color.label: Ink
color.description: Ink override — every logo shape fills with this color.
